title: Pure Cosmic Dragon
summary: Pure Cosmic Dragon (Yang Zing) multi-Attribute Wyrm Synchro build with Mare Mare and generic high-Level Dragon Synchro bosses. Every Main Deck Yang Zing floats into another from the Deck when destroyed, and each non-Tuner permanently buffs any Synchro Monster summoned using it.

summary.title: Starters
points: Jiaotu, Darkness of the Yang Zing (Level 2 Tuner) sends 2 Yang Zing cards from your hand to the GY while you control no other monsters to Special Summon 1 Yang Zing with 0 ATK and 1 with 0 DEF from the Deck.

Denglong, First of the Yang Zing (Level 5 Synchro Tuner) searches any Yang Zing card (such as Nine Pillars of Yang Zing or Yang Zing Path) on Special Summon, sends a Wyrm from the Deck to the GY to match its Level, and summons a Yang Zing from the Deck when it leaves the field.
Yazi, Evil of the Yang Zing pops a Yang Zing you control and an opponent's card, and when destroyed it Special Summons Mare Mare from the Deck to generate up to 3 Level 1 Mini-Mare Mare Tokens.

summary.title: Opening: Jiaotu, Darkness of the Yang Zing
steps: Normal Summon Jiaotu while your field is empty and send 2 Yang Zing cards from your hand to the GY to Special Summon Zefraniu, Secret of the Yang Zing (0 ATK) and Bixi, Water of the Yang Zing or Suanni, Fire of the Yang Zing (0 DEF) from the Deck.

Synchro Summon Baxia, Brightness of the Yang Zing using Jiaotu (Level 2) and Zefraniu (Level 6), then use Baxia's effect to destroy your other Yang Zing and revive Jiaotu from the GY while the destroyed Yang Zing floats into Chiwen, Light of the Yang Zing.

Synchro Summon Denglong, First of the Yang Zing to search Nine Pillars of Yang Zing, dump a Wyrm to adjust Denglong's Level, and climb into Chaofeng, Draco Berserker of the Tenyi, or Crimson Dragon into Cosmic Blazar Dragon.

summary.title: Synchro Buffs & Quick-Synchros
points: Non-Tuner Yang Zings grant permanent bonuses to Synchros made with them: Bixi grants Trap immunity, Pulao grants Spell immunity, Bi'an grants battle-destruction immunity, Suanni grants +500 ATK/DEF, and Taotie prevents control from switching.

Bi'an, Bixi, and Pulao can trigger during the opponent's Main Phase or Battle Phase to Quick-Synchro using only Yang Zing monsters you control, dropping Baxia to spin opposing cards or Chaofeng on the opponent's turn.

summary.title: Control, Spells & Traps
points: Nine Pillars of Yang Zing is a searchable Counter Trap that negates any Spell, Trap, or monster effect, shuffles that card into the Deck, and destroys a Yang Zing you control to trigger its float and revive Chiwen from the GY.
Chaofeng, Phantom of the Yang Zing locks the opponent out of activating monster effects matching the original Attributes of the Yang Zing materials used for its Synchro Summon.
Yang Zing Path shuffles 3 Yang Zing monsters from the GY into the Deck to draw 2 cards, while Yang Zing Prana pops a Yang Zing during the End Phase to float and wipes opposing monsters after battle.

allow.Mare Mare: Level 7 WATER Wyrm Tuner summoned from the Deck via Yazi, Evil of the Yang Zing that generates up to 3 Mini-Mare Mare Tokens.
allow.Cosmic Blazar Dragon: Ultimate Synchro boss providing an all-encompassing Quick Effect negation.
allow.Draco Berserker of the Tenyi: Generic Level 8 Wyrm Synchro for the Yang Zing climb; banishes a monster whose effect the opponent activates. Replaces Crystal Wing Synchro Dragon, Forbidden since October 2026.

main: Jiaotu, Darkness of the Yang Zing
Level 2 DARK Wyrm Tuner that floats when destroyed and sends 2 Yang Zing cards from hand to GY to summon 1 Yang Zing with 0 ATK and 1 with 0 DEF from the Deck.
Chiwen, Light of the Yang Zing
Level 1 LIGHT Wyrm Tuner that floats from Deck when destroyed OR revives itself from the GY whenever another Yang Zing you control is destroyed.
Suanni, Fire of the Yang Zing
Level 4 FIRE Wyrm that floats when destroyed and permanently grants +500 ATK/DEF to any Synchro Monster summoned using it.
Bi'an, Earth of the Yang Zing
Level 3 EARTH Wyrm that floats when destroyed, grants battle destruction immunity to a Synchro Monster, and Quick-Synchros on the opponent's turn.
Pulao, Wind of the Yang Zing
Level 1 WIND Wyrm that floats when destroyed, grants Spell immunity to a Synchro Monster, and Quick-Synchros on the opponent's turn.
Bixi, Water of the Yang Zing
Level 2 WATER Wyrm that floats when destroyed, grants complete Trap immunity to a Synchro Monster, and Quick-Synchros on the opponent's turn.
Taotie, Shadow of the Yang Zing
Level 5 DARK Wyrm that floats when destroyed and prevents control of the Synchro Monster from switching.
Zefraniu, Secret of the Yang Zing
Level 6 EARTH Wyrm Pendulum that searches any Yang Zing Spell/Trap when Pendulum Summoned or destroyed on the field.
Mare Mare
Summoned from the Deck when Yazi is destroyed, reducing its Level to summon 3 Level 1 Wyrm Tokens for Denglong and Baxia.
Yang Zing Path
Shuffles 3 Yang Zing monsters from the GY into the Deck to draw 2 cards.
Yang Zing Prana
Continuous Spell that destroys a Yang Zing you control during the End Phase to trigger its float and pops all monsters your opponent controls after Battle.
Nine Pillars of Yang Zing
Counter Trap that negates ANY Spell/Trap or monster effect, shuffles it into the Deck, and destroys a Yang Zing you control to trigger its float.
extra: Denglong, First of the Yang Zing
Level 5 Synchro Tuner that searches any Yang Zing card (including Nine Pillars) on Summon, dumps a Wyrm to modulate its Level, and floats into a Yang Zing when leaving the field.
Baxia, Brightness of the Yang Zing
Level 8 Synchro boss that shuffles cards on the field into the Deck equal to the number of different Attributes used, and pops a card you control to revive a Level 4 or lower monster.
Yazi, Evil of the Yang Zing
Level 7 Synchro that cannot be targeted by opponent's card effects, destroys 1 Yang Zing and 1 opponent's card, and summons Mare Mare from the Deck when destroyed.
Chaofeng, Phantom of the Yang Zing
Level 9 Synchro boss that locks the opponent out of activating monster effects matching the Attributes of the Yang Zing materials used to summon it.
Level 12 Synchro: banishes itself until End Phase to negate a summon, card effect activation, or attack.
Generic Level 8 Wyrm Synchro: banishes a monster whose effect the opponent activates.
Level 10 Synchro: Special Summons a banished LIGHT/DARK monster, and shuffles a banished card to destroy or negate.
Level 12 Synchro: targets a Level 7+ Synchro to return itself and cheat out another Dragon Synchro of equal Level.
